You shout a warning before the blow lands, then direct your companion out of the next attacker’s reach.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One willing ally within 5 squares that can hear you, before its defense against an attack.
Duration
The triggering defense and subsequent movement.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature

Grant 2 Boons to that defense. After the entire attack resolves, the ally may move up to 3 squares without provoking if still able.

Additional rulings
